bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up the iHealth {name} blood pressure monitor? Home Assistant will sync it each time it wakes up after a measurement.

bluetooth_confirm_untested.description:
Set up the iHealth {name} blood pressure monitor? Home Assistant will sync it each time it wakes up after a measurement.

This cuff uses older firmware ({variant}) that is supported but **untested**. Please report how it goes, with debug logs, on the project issue tracker.

user.description: Choose the blood pressure monitor to set up. Take a measurement (or wake the cuff) first so Home Assistant can see it.

abort.no_devices_found: No iHealth KN-550BT monitors were seen. Wake the cuff (take a measurement) near a Bluetooth adapter or proxy and try again.
abort.not_supported: This iHealth device is not a supported blood pressure monitor.

data.delete_after_import: Delete readings from the cuff after importing them (this is what the iHealth app does — turn off if you still use the app)
data.review_mode: Hold new readings for review before importing them
data.morning_start: Morning window starts (also when a new BP day begins)
data.evening_end: Evening window ends (may be after midnight)
data.routine_start: Count readings toward the baseline from this date

data_description.delete_after_import: Readings are only deleted after Home Assistant has saved them. With this off, the cuff keeps its readings (up to 99) for the iHealth app.
data_description.review_mode: New readings appear unticked in the Readings list. Tick a reading to import it, or delete it to discard it.

error.invalid_windows: The windows must not overlap: morning, then evening, all within 24 hours starting at the morning start.

unsupported_device.title: Unsupported iHealth device
unsupported_device.description: The device at {address} reports model {model}, which is not a KN-550BT blood pressure monitor. Remove this integration entry; nothing is read from the device.

pending.name: Pending until the cuff next connects
Pending until the cuff next connects

delete_reading.name: Delete reading
delete_reading.description: Deletes a blood pressure reading from Home Assistant (its statistics and the Readings list). Events already fired are not undone.

measured_at.name: Measured at
measured_at.description: When the reading was taken (local time, to the second).

reading_not_found.message: No reading was found at that time.

device_not_found.message: That device is not a loaded iHealth Blood Pressure monitor.

item_change_not_allowed.message: Readings cannot be renamed or un-ticked. Tick a pending reading to import it, or delete it.
